fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Station Master Online Form 2026 (1265 Posts) – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the notification for the post of Station Master Posts on the official website of RRB. This recruitment has released for 1265 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 has started from 27 October 2026, & candidate can apply until 25 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 October 2026
  • Last Date : 25 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 November 2026
  • Correction / Modified Form : 28 November 2026 to 07 December 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
